title: Oscar and the Protocol
author: Ada Voss
blurb: Vesper Galloway, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
